turns.question: Who was the most clutch shooter?
turns.sql: SELECT sd.player_name, COUNT(*) AS clutch_attempts, SUM(sd.shot_made_flag) AS clutch_makes, ROUND(AVG(sd.shot_made_flag)::numeric, 3) AS clutch_fg_pct FROM nba.shot_detail sd JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT CASE WHEN pe.scoremargin = 'TIE' THEN 0 ELSE pe.scoremargin::int END AS margin_val FROM nba.pbp_event pe WHERE pe.game_id = sd.game_id AND pe.eventnum <= sd.game_event_id AND pe.scoremargin IS NOT NULL ORDER BY pe.eventnum DESC LIMIT 1 ) m ON true WHERE sd.period >= 4 AND sd.minutes_remaining <= 5 AND ABS(m.margin_val) <= 5 GROUP BY sd.player_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20 ORDER BY clutch_fg_pct DESC LIMIT 1;
turns.summary: Defined 'clutch' using the NBA's standard definition: 4th quarter or overtime, 5 minutes or less remaining, and score within 5 points at the time of the shot (score margin taken from the most recent play-by-play event with a non-null scoremargin). Restricted to players with at least 20 clutch field-goal attempts and ranked by field-goal percentage.

turns.summary: Counts made field goals (shot_detail only, so free throws aren't included) by player where period = 4 and the game clock remaining is 2:00 or less, then returns the player with the most makes.
